project_name: DeCew Falls GS No. 1 & 2 (ND1 & NF23) Communications Site Upgrade Technical Specification

ELE.scope_of_work: The project involves designing, constructing, installing, and commissioning a new communications network at the DeCew site, including establishing communication rooms with reliable power systems for up to 8 hours of runtime upon loss of station service power. The scope includes electrical installations for IT, SCADA, and security systems, as well as upgrades to existing electrical infrastructure.
ELE.required_activities: Activities include installing 600VAC distribution panels, 120/240V lighting transformers, critical distribution panels, and UPS battery solutions for IT loads. The project also involves providing power to IT racks, SCADA systems, and security systems, ensuring compatibility with existing electrical systems, and obtaining ESA certification for all panels and installations.

AUX.scope_of_work: The auxiliary scope includes designing and installing HVAC systems to maintain acceptable environmental conditions for IT/OT equipment, ensuring fire protection systems are compatible with existing infrastructure, and providing emergency lighting systems integrated with the Nexus RF wireless system.
AUX.required_activities: Activities include designing HVAC systems to control temperature and humidity, installing fire detection and suppression systems, ensuring emergency lighting compatibility with Nexus RF systems, and integrating HVAC and fire systems with the building's operational requirements. The contractor must also ensure compliance with OBC and NFPA standards.
AUX.HVAC_and_FAS: HVAC systems to control temperature and humidity; fire detection and suppression systems
